title: Microsoft Licensing in the Copilot Credits Era - CRM Rocks Podcast
description: AI-generated visual companion to CRM Rocks Episode 165, in which Markus Erlandsson and Jukka Niiranen examine the shift from predictable per-user licensing to consumption-based AI economics. It covers Copilot credits, Copilot Studio harnesses, Work IQ, autonomous-agent governance, and the unresolved cost model for AI agents.
